title: Knowledge Map extracted PDF page
description: One source PDF page. Extracted text is immutable source output; generated interpretations are separate.

document_id.description: Stable identifier shared by every page in the source document.

page_number.description: One-based PDF page index; distinct from any printed page number.

printed_page_number.description: Printed page label if reliably identified; otherwise null.

extracted_text.description: Uncorrected text selected by the extraction workflow (PyMuPDF or Tesseract). Never replace with a model correction.

pymupdf_text.description: Original PyMuPDF text-layer result before OCR fallback, when available.

content_type.description: Page-level content category. Use unknown rather than guessing from text length alone.

extraction_method.description: Method that produced extracted_text. Vision-generated descriptions belong in interpretations, not extracted_text.

quality_status.description: no_text_detected means only that no usable text was obtained; it does not assert a visually blank page.

associated_assets.description: Optional source-page, image, table, or figure references. Keep source document/page provenance with each reference.

interpretations.description: Optional derived human or model output. Never overwrite extracted_text or pymupdf_text.
